title: Ermittlungen nach Schussabgaben führen zur Festnahme eines Tatverdächtigen

extraction.summaryEn: In March 2026, several shots were fired during an altercation on Karl-Marx-Straße, injuring an uninvolved 24-year-old in the leg. A 40-year-old suspect was arrested on 24 July 2026 in Sonnenallee.
